context_for_next_testing_agent: All robot and irrigation backend APIs are working correctly. Robot endpoints use in-memory robot_states dictionary for agribot-001 and agribot-002. Irrigation control POST endpoint accepts action (start/stop/pause) with optional duration_minutes. ParcelCreate model accepts both French (culture_type, surface_hectares) and English (crop_type, area_hectares) field names as aliases.

robot_status.details: Returns 2 robots: agribot-001 (AgriBot Alpha, actif) and agribot-002 (AgriBot Beta, maintenance)

robot_control.details: Supports actions: start, stop, scan_area, move_forward, pause, resume, return_home, capture_3d, patrol, etc.

robot_3d_map.details: Returns point_cloud with 125000 total_points, sample_points, detected_features, terrain_analysis, ai_analysis, sarsa_predictions

robot_move.details: Supports directions: forward, backward, left, right, stop. Updates position and heading in robot_states.

robot_telemetry.details: Returns battery (percent, voltage, current_draw), position (lat, lng, altitude), speed_kmh, motors, sensors_health, connection, environment

robot_waypoint.details: Adds navigation waypoint with latitude, longitude, action_on_arrival. Stores in robot_waypoints collection.

robot_history.details: Returns command history from robot_commands collection with statistics

irrigation_control.details: Supports actions: start, stop, pause, manual. Optional duration_minutes parameter.

create_parcel.details: Accepts culture_type (alias for crop_type) and surface_hectares (alias for area_hectares)

dashboard_stats.details: Returns parcels_count, average_humidity, average_temperature, active_alerts, active_sensors, etc.

sensors.details: Returns list of sensors (no auth required)

alerts.details: Returns list of alerts for authenticated user

mocked_apis.robot_endpoints: MOCKED - Robot data is simulated in real-time using in-memory robot_states dictionary. No real robot hardware connected.
mocked_apis.camera_ia: MOCKED - Camera analysis uses simulated data
mocked_apis.mobile_money: MOCKED - Payment works in simulation mode
